task.definition: For each EStG-150 record, predict character regions that are rule clauses. Gold is every clauses[].clause_span in the frozen Stage 2 Gold. This is a clause-segmentation subtask of Stage 2, not six-element extraction.

metric.match_rule: a predicted clause region counts as matched if it intersects at least one Gold clause_span; a Gold clause_span counts as matched if at least one predicted region intersects it; counts are global over statements, with no one-to-one clause assignment

not_claimed: Sun et al. (2024) Table 12 BPMN violation detection
Winter et al. (2020) BPMN-model matching/fitness/cost on EStG-150
action span equivalence of Winter obligation clauses

winter_2020_native_clause_regions.display_name: Winter et al. (2020) native clause regions

interpretation_boundary.reason: Sun Table 12 compares violation detection on a proprietary smart-meter BPMN case; EStG-150 has no BPMN models and this run does not recreate that task. The clause-region task is an explicit adaptation, so the numbers are not directly comparable to Sun's published Winter-vs-Sun table.

claim_boundary: This is a zero-API first predecessor-baseline result on the frozen EStG-150 Stage 2 corpus. Winter is evaluated only on the adapted clause-region subtask; its native match/cost task on proprietary BPMN models is not reproduced. Rules-Only and Direct-LLM numbers are historical capsules reused read-only, not new calls. Sun's published Table 12 cannot be compared directly to this task.
